newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China provinces try to curb illicit stock trading.
newsitem.headline: China provinces try to curb illicit stock trading.

text.p: Securities authorities in the south China provinces of Hainan and Hunan have launched a crackdown on illicit stock trading, the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said on Friday.
The move is in line with the government policy of eliminating excessive speculation on the country's stock markets, the newspaper said.

It said securities regulators in the two provinces have started to investigate whether local brokerages have illegally provided credit to clients for stock trading or used clients' funds to buy shares without telling them.
Securities companies found to be involved in illegal practices such as insider dealing face severe punishment, the newspaper said without elaborating.
The investigations in Hainan started December 12 and will end on December 25, it added without giving more details.
